content: CSLib is falling CI on the main branch because of toolchain mismatch with docs.
Thanks for pointing this out. I asked about this at #general > docgen v4.29.0-rc1 release before seeing your message.
This should be resolved with the latest docgen release now in. I have triggered a rebuild of the docs and will consider what CI change we might make to prevent this in the future.
One CI solution is to specially tag toolchain update PRs with a label, and enable a toolchain check for doc gen in the CI for those PRs.
(I am aware this situation has arisen again, should be temporary)
